title: Design System: Anatome VR learning interface

display.purpose: Ordinary native Unity page headings: 40 canvas units, TMP bold, before user text scale.

headline.purpose: 40-unit bold title, including settings category pages; preferred wrapped height controls layout.

title.purpose: Workspace and current objective: 31 canvas units, TMP bold.

body.purpose: Default TextMeshPro reading text; source helper uses lineSpacing 3 and user text scale.

label.purpose: 24-unit bold button labels; native sibling heights follow the longest wrapped label.

caption.purpose: 20-unit narration caption with independent caption scale, in a reserved non-scrolling band.

card-title.purpose: 28-unit bold activity/unit name; wraps and grows the card.

card-description.purpose: 21-unit muted description; 20-unit optional availability text is separate.

motion.name: Immediate control tint
motion.purpose: Native button/card hover, selected, pressed and disabled tint; no animated transforms.

nativeMaterial.highContrast: Skips the vertical vertex gradient; black main panels and white text/border tint. Shared masks remain.
nativeMaterial.previewNote: CSS gradients and inset shadows approximate native vertex shading and bevel masks. They are documentation previews, not runtime shaders. Synthesized tonal ramps are swatch previews, not additional runtime tokens.

narrative.overview:
The specimen leads. A floating smoked-blue glass console teaches one action at a time beside the learner's hands. Polished edges, stationary vertical shading, cool ivory Source Sans 3 text and sea-glass primary controls give the interface a dimensional material. Source anatomy pictures make learning choices recognizable before the learner reads their descriptions. Neutral tissue lighting carries anatomical form separately from the UI palette.

The user-pinned 3D glass direction governs version 1.5.0 and supersedes seed 4eb97167. The build remains code-led (.impeccable/config.json sets buildPath to code). Equal sibling button geometry, separated navigation and reserved controls support operation inside VR; material effects remain subordinate to readable instructions.
keyCharacteristics: One practical action at a time
Smoked-blue glass with stationary bevels and a dimensional outer edge
Equal sibling controls that grow with wrapped labels
Native controller input and reserved status, captions and settings actions
Source anatomy artwork with recorded provenance

rules.name: Read the whole instruction
rules.body: Use preferred text heights and scroll overflow; never overlap essential text.

rules.name: One current action
rules.body: Keep advanced tools and mode changes on separate pages.

rules.name: Stationary glass
rules.body: Build material depth from the shared gradient, bevel masks and outer edge; keep readability and high contrast intact.

dos: Do use shared glass surfaces and button sizing instead of page-specific copies.
Do keep navigation, status, captions and fixed actions outside the scrolling content they control.
Do show difficulty locks, availability and account state in words.
Do preserve source anatomy proportions, provenance and actual controller press, hold, drag, release and scroll.
Do separate source checks, player captures, simulator checks and physical-headset acceptance.
donts: Don't let wrapped text or slider handles draw over adjacent controls.
Don't add runtime blur, screen-space refraction or animated panel motion to simulate glass.
Don't restore the desktop anatomy gameplay path or let camera fitting move the learner's headset.
Don't award credit from a UI finish button or a teaching aid.
Don't infer comfort, clinical validity or headset FPS from screenshots or simulator tests.

vrRevision.flow: One current action; practical orientation; Easy mastery before Medium and Hard

canvas.rotation: Faces headset position with world up; looking down does not lower the panel into the support surface.

vrRevision.status: Implemented native glass system. Read the final player and simulator reports for their tested revisions. Physical-headset acceptance, wearer comfort and headset performance remain separate.

rows: Guide / Menu or Pause / signed-in Log out

surface.edge: bright upper outline, darkened fill perimeter and separate offset outer edge
surface.material: LabGlassTint stationary vertex gradient and shared bevel masks

button.siblingHeight: LabButtonHeight measures the longest active sibling label at its actual available width
button.siblingWidth: equal flexible widths with zero minimum/preferred width

icons.method: Authored vector geometry with consistent stroke and minimum-rectangle-side square sizing

artwork.source: Temporary URP preview-scene instances of the existing Thorax.fbx
artwork.interpretation: Healthy source anatomy; selection tint is interface emphasis. Omitted coverings and exploded translations are recorded. No fabricated diagnostic or treatment images.

vrRevision.historyPolicy: Prior review folders are retained in place as historical evidence. Their captures and benchmarks do not establish acceptance of the current revision.

account.logout: Header visible only when Account.UserId exists; calls LabRuntime.LogOut
account.scope: Current-device session through AccountService.SignOut; save first, retain account-isolated progress and PIN-protected offline access
account.notice: Signed-in account state replaces guest-session notice
